platform.README.md:
# Platform

## Toolset limits
Toolsets support up to 128 tools. Registration accepts every toolset within that limit.

## Receiver payload limits
The receiver accepts payloads up to eight mebibytes. Larger payloads are rejected.

## Receiver retry policy
Receiver retries always wait five seconds before sending again.

## Installation
Install the receiver chart with helm install receiver ./charts/receiver.

def test_toolset_limit():
    """A toolset containing 33 tools must be rejected."""
    with raises(ValueError):
        validate_toolset(["tool"] * 33)

def test_receiver_payload_limit():
    """Receiver payloads above one mebibyte must be rejected."""
    with raises(ValueError):
        accept_payload(b"x" * (1024 * 1024 + 1))

def attach_agent_attributes(span, session, model):
    """Every coding-agent span carries session.id and model.name attributes."""
    span.set_attribute("session.id", session.id)
    span.set_attribute("model.name", model.name)
coding-plugin.src/errors.py:
def record_agent_error(span, error):
    """The coding-agent plugin records error.type and marks failed spans ERROR."""
    span.set_attribute("error.type", type(error).__name__)
    span.set_status("ERROR")
coding-plugin.docs/telemetry.md:
# Telemetry guide
The coding-agent plugin reports work through the receiver. To inspect telemetry locally, start the collector and set OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT to http://localhost:4318.
